title: Open app without an observed window is not success
scenario: Coordinator runs one open_app step; the agent says ok but the node reports verified='unconfirmed' (no window appeared).
expected: Task status 'failed', step passed=False, the owner summary does not start with 'Done'.

title: Website opened in the wrong Chrome profile
scenario: open_website for profile 'Default'; the agent reports ok with a window, but in 'Profile 1'.
expected: Task status 'failed', step not passed, no 'Done' in the summary.

title: A different video playing is not the asked one
scenario: play_media for 'kalyani'; the agent reports playing=True but same_video=False (a different result is playing).
expected: Task status 'failed', step not passed.

title: Open file without a window showing it is not success
scenario: open_file 'report.docx'; the node opened it but reports verified='unconfirmed' (no window titled like the file appeared).
expected: Task status 'failed', step not passed, summary does not say 'Done'.

result.note: no window titled like 'report' appeared within 6 s

title: Signed-in account differs from the expected one
scenario: browser whoami step; the node sees account 'ris***' but 'ven***' was expected (matches=False).
expected: Task status 'failed', step not passed.

title: Transient browser failure is retried once only
scenario: open_website fails twice with 'browser connection failed: McpError timeout'.
expected: Exactly 2 attempts (one retry), task status 'failed'.

title: Transient failure then success completes
scenario: open_website fails once with 'timed out', then the retry opens the window in the right profile.
expected: 2 attempts, task status 'completed'.

results.error: timed out waiting for the browser

title: Kernel refusal is not retried
scenario: The open_app agent raises DesktopError('refused by policy: launching that program is not allowed') (an HTTP 403 from the console).
expected: Exactly 1 attempt, task status 'failed'.

results.raise: refused by policy: launching that program is not allowed

title: Owner denial is not retried
scenario: A browser click step comes back state='denied' (the owner refused the approval).
expected: Exactly 1 attempt, task status 'denied'.

title: Typing that timed out is never retried
scenario: A type_text step returns 'no result within 60 s; timed out' - the text may already have been typed.
expected: Exactly 1 attempt (a retry could type the text twice), task status 'failed'.

results.error: no result within 60 s; timed out, it was cancelled

title: Typing is read back from the field
scenario: winbackend.type_text with the PowerShell runner faked: the read-back script reports the text is not in the field.
expected: Scripts run in order FOCUS, TYPE, READBACK and the action raises 'ui-action-failed:text not in field' (no false success).

title: Approval needed ends the task with the question
scenario: Step 1 (open_app) comes back waiting_for_permission with approval id ap-7; step 2 (type_text) follows.
expected: Status 'waiting_for_permission', approval_id ap-7 kept, step 2 never runs, summary asks for approval.

title: One PC task at a time
scenario: A first task holds the PC-task lock; a second coordinator run starts.
expected: Second run status 'busy', its agent is never called, the error names the running task.

title: Lock race between eight threads
scenario: Eight threads call coordinator.acquire on the same lock file at the same instant (barrier).
expected: Exactly one acquires; the lock file names that winner.

title: Lock of a crashed task is taken over
scenario: The lock file names a process that has exited (a real child process, waited).
expected: acquire() succeeds and the lock names the new task.

title: Lock older than its budget is taken over
scenario: The lock names a live process but is older than the 600 s budget plus 60 s (a hung task).
expected: acquire() succeeds and the lock names the new task.

title: Agent crash releases the lock
scenario: The window agent raises RuntimeError mid-step; afterwards another task runs.
expected: First task 'failed' with the error, no lock file left, the next task is not 'busy'.

title: Cancel between steps
scenario: The owner says stop while step 1 runs; step 2 (typing) is next.
expected: Status 'cancelled', step 2 never runs, summary starts 'Stopped.' (it may name what already happened before the stop).

title: Cancel during a step is reported as cancelled
scenario: The owner stops while a typing job runs; the job comes back state='cancelled'.
expected: Task status 'cancelled' (not 'failed'), no retry (1 attempt).

title: Stop reaches the job that is running
scenario: core.Pc waits for job j1 (never finishes); the owner's stop sets Pc.stopped on the 2nd poll.
expected: The console receives POST job/cancel for j1 and Pc.run returns state 'cancelled'.

title: Node cancel kills the job's process
scenario: jarvis_node.runtime runs a 60 s child process for job 'bench-job'; cancel('some-other-job') then cancel('bench-job').
expected: Wrong id returns False; right id returns True; the handler gets Cancelled in under 10 s.

title: Job that never finishes is cancelled at its timeout
scenario: core.Pc.run with a 5 s timeout; the fake console never finishes job j1.
expected: State 'failed', error 'no result within 5 s', and job/cancel sent for j1.

title: Unanswered approval tells the owner how
scenario: An edit needs approval; the owner never answers within the wait.
expected: State 'waiting_for_permission', approval_id a1, 'PIN' in how, no job run and the request not re-sent.

title: Stop while an approval is pending
scenario: An edit waits for approval; the owner says stop before approving.
expected: Pc.run returns state 'cancelled' (not waiting_for_permission), no job, request not re-sent.

title: Click without an expectation is unverified
scenario: control.Controller.do('click', 'notepad|Save') with no expectation function.
expected: Result status 'unverified' (never 'verified').

title: Unexpected dialog after a click
scenario: Clicking Save raises a 'Confirm Save As' dialog instead of saving; the same click is then tried again.
expected: First result 'mismatch'; the repeat raises RepeatError; the backend was clicked once.

title: Kernel refusal stops the UI action
scenario: The kernel's /authorize answers allowed=False for a type action.
expected: Result 'refused' and the backend is never called.

title: UI error text never leaves the node
scenario: The backend raises an error whose text contains screen content (an OTP).
expected: Result 'error' with detail exactly 'RuntimeError'; no OTP in the detail.

title: Raw key syntax and injected targets refused
scenario: winbackend.sendkeys with '{ENTER}', 'ctrl+ctrl+x', '%{F4}', 'win+r', 'ctrl+shift+'; _split with injected process names; launch('cmd').
expected: All 5 keys and 4 targets raise ValueError; 'ctrl+shift+t' maps to '^+t'; launching cmd is refused.

title: Task record keeps no screen text
scenario: An inspect step returns page text with an OTP and a local result path.
expected: The saved task record contains neither the OTP text nor the local file name.

title: Uncertainty is told, not hidden
scenario: A play step passes (same video, playing) but Windows' media session shows a different title.
expected: Status 'completed' and the summary contains 'not certain'.

title: Time budget stops the task
scenario: Four open_app steps each take 400 s (fake clock); budget 600 s.
expected: Status 'failed' with 'budget' in the error after exactly 2 steps ran.

title: Coordinator overhead
scenario: Coordinator.run of 5 verified open_app steps with instant fake agents (lock, verification, record on disk); decision supplied.
expected: Completed in under 150 ms (time.perf_counter).

title: Modern (UWP) app: Calculator 1+2=3
scenario: On the laptop: open Calculator (ApplicationFrameHost window), press 1 + 2 =, read the display back by name.
expected: Display reads 3; the single matching frame is used (two matching frames are refused).

title: Installer dialog read and closed by name
scenario: On the laptop: 'msiexec /?' shows its help dialog; Neko reads it and presses OK by element name.
expected: Dialog text read locally, OK pressed by name (not by position), the dialog is gone afterwards.

title: Typing under the foreground lock
scenario: On the laptop: another app holds the foreground; Neko types into Notepad via the keyboard rung.
expected: Notepad is brought to the front or the action fails with 'target is not the foreground window'; no keys land elsewhere.

title: Real typing read back in WordPad
scenario: On the laptop: type 'dear sir' into WordPad (RichEdit, no value pattern) and read it back via WM_GETTEXT.
expected: Success only when the text is read back from the field.

title: Save-changes dialog appears mid-task
scenario: On the laptop: closing Notepad with unsaved text raises 'Do you want to save changes?' during a task.
expected: The dialog is seen and reported; no button is pressed without the owner; the task is not reported done.
